messages.subject: Downloading data from yahoo finace
parts:
Hi, 

I've deployed an app that needs data from yahoo finance using quantmod package. Locally works perfectly but in the server cannot connect. Do you know if there is a firewall or I need upgrade my account?

Thank you,

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Re: Downloading data from yahoo finace
parts:
Hi Pedro,

You are possibly hitting rate limits imposed by Yahoo per IP address. If others are running similar API calls, you may or may not receive data, resulting in a bit of confusion as to why it works sometimes but not at other times. 

https://developer.yahoo.com/yql/guide/usage_info_limits.html

One way around this is obtaining an API key and using it in your app. 

https://developer.apps.yahoo.com/dashboard/createKey.html

Best regards,
